title: Mayon test tier exemptions
description: Deliberate exceptions to the guardrail rules in specs/032-test-suite-tiering/contracts/guardrails.md. Keep this list empty unless an exemption has a non-empty justification; an unjustified entry is itself a TT-000 violation.

file.description: Repository-relative path of the exempt file.

rule.description: Stable guardrail ID such as TT-002.

justification.description: Why the exemption is needed and when it should be removed.
